usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and wizishop corrects stock through “Update SKU stock” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update SKU stock” in wizishop
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation can raise a SKU's stock by an amount, so shelves match reality.

watchOut: “Update SKU stock” can increase, decrease or replace the amount, so choose the mode or stock drifts.
